data.name: Uzzian
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name Uzziah, meaning 'my strength is Yahweh'. Uzzian was the name of a king of Judah who ruled for fifty-two years in peace and prosperity. He was known for his great devotion to God and his religious reforms, and was also a skilled musician. Uzzian's story serves as an inspiration for those seeking to serve God and lead their communities with wisdom and strength.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek to honor God with their strength and abilities.

They have a great ability to express their ideas and emotions, and they are often very charismatic and sociable.

in_hebrew.name: עוזיאן
in_hebrew.meaning: כוח, גבורה, ועז, שם שמשמעותו כוח וגבורה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עוזיאן הוא שם יהודי-נבטי השייך לקבוצת שמות שמשמעותם כוח וגבורה. השם עוזיאן נמצא בספר ישעיה ונזכר כגבור מלכי יהודה. על פי המסורת, השם עוזיאן היה צדיק ומנהיג העם, והשם נחשב לטוב ומוערך. במקרא, השם עוזיאן נזכר כבן צדיק ומנהיג. ביהדות, השם עוזיאן נחשב לשם כבוד ומוערך.

in_greek.name: Οὐζιάννης
in_greek.meaning: ἰσχύς, ἀρετή, καὶ δύναμις, ὄνομα τοῦ ὁποίου ἡ ἐπίδους ἕνεκα ἰσχύς καὶ ἀρετή
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὀὐζιάννης ἕτερος τύπος τοῦ ὀνόματος Ὀζίας, ἡ ἐτυμολογία τοῦ ὀνόματος συνδέεται με τὴν ἰσχύν καὶ τὴν ἀρετὴν. Ὁ ἅγιος Γρηγόριος τοῦ Νύσσης ἔγραψε ὅτι ὁ Ὀὐζιάννης ἦταν ἕνας ἀπὸ τῶν ἐνδόξων ἄνδρων τῆς Ἐκκλησίας. Τὸ ὄνομα Ὀὐζιάννης πιστεύεται ὅτι δίνεται σὲ ἀνθρώπους με ἀρετὴ καὶ ἰσχύ.

in_latin.name: Uzzianus
in_latin.meaning: virtus, fortitudo, et potentia, nomen cuius significatio virtus et fortitudo
in_latin.long_meaning: Uzzianus est nomen Christianum quod significat virtutem et fortitudinem. In historia Ecclesiae, nomen Uzzianus est datum hominibus virtutibus et fortitudine notis. In traditione Christiana, Uzzianus est consideratus nomen bonum et venerabile.

data.cultural_impact: King Uzzian, also known as Azariah or Uzzah, was a powerful and influential monarch who ruled over Judah in the 8th century BCE. His name symbolized his unwavering faith in God, with 'Uzz' meaning 'my strength' and 'ian' meaning 'God'. Under his rule, Judah experienced a period of peace and prosperity, and he is remembered for his military conquests, administrative achievements, and religious reforms.
data.spiritual_significance: Uzzian's name embodies the Christian ideals of faith and strength. His reign was marked by his deep commitment to God, and he is often seen as a model of leadership for those seeking to serve their communities with wisdom, righteousness, and devotion. Uzzian's story reminds us that true strength comes from our connection to God, and that our faith should be the foundation of our actions and decisions. Additionally, his role as a skilled musician highlights the importance of creative expression in our spiritual journey, as music can be a powerful tool for expressing our love and devotion to God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Uzzian is mentioned in the Bible as the father of King Jotham of Judah. [2 Chronicles 27:1] The name Uzzian carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Uzzian is believed to have reigned over Judah for twenty-seven years during the Babylonian captivity of Hezekiah.

historical_references.reference: The prophet Isaiah refers to Uzzian as a godless king who did evil in the eyes of the Lord. [Isaiah 6:1]
historical_references.context: Uzzian is mentioned as one of the kings who did not acknowledge God or seek His guidance during a time of judgment and destruction by the Babylonians.
